description: Initial docker-compose for containerized environment setup

hunks.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+# todo on llm-host: loopback only, tailscale serve fronts it on :8443.
+services:
+  todo:
+    build: .
+    image: todo:local
+    container_name: todo
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    ports:
+      - "127.0.0.1:8090:8090" # loopback; never exposed directly
+    environment:
+      PB_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${PB_ENCRYPTION_KEY:?set PB_ENCRYPTION_KEY in .env}
+    volumes:
+      - todo_data:/app/pb_data
+
+volumes:
+  todo_data:
